# AI Bill & Expiry Date Alert Telegram Bot

> Smart Telegram assistant that tracks grocery expirations, medication schedules, utility bills, and warranty renewals using Google Gemini 2.0 Flash Vision AI and automated daily reminders.

## Project Overview
- **Name:** Product Expiry & Bill Alert Bot
- **Repository:** https://github.com/Mazonia/product-expiry-bot
- **License:** MIT
- **Runtime:** Python 3.10+
- **Core Dependencies:** `python-telegram-bot` v21+, `google-genai` (Gemini 2.0 Flash), `apscheduler`, `sqlite3`

## Key Capabilities
- **Gemini Vision OCR:** Users take a photo of any grocery product, medicine box, utility invoice, or receipt. Gemini extracts item name, expiration/due date, category, and amount automatically.
- **Proactive Notification Engine:** Automated background scheduler checks items every morning:
  - Critical Same-Day Alert: For items expiring or bills due today.
  - 3-Day Final Warning: Pre-expiration reminder for groceries and medications.
  - 7-Day Early Warning: Planning reminder for bills and subscription renewals.
- **Financial Bill Tracker:** Calculates total pending unpaid bill sums and upcoming payment deadlines (`/bills`).
- **Pantry & Fridge Manager:** List items expiring within custom day ranges (`/expiring 5`) to eliminate food waste.
- **Local SQLite Persistence:** Complete offline privacy. All item records and notification timestamps are stored in a local SQLite database.

## Quickstart & Installation

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/Mazonia/product-expiry-bot.git
cd product-expiry-bot

# Set up virtual environment
python -m venv venv
.\venv\Scripts\activate

# Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Configure bot token and Gemini API key
copy .env.example .env
# Edit .env with TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_USER_ID, and GEMINI_API_KEY

# Launch the bot
python bot.py
```

## Primary Commands
- `/start` - Welcome message and quick instructions
- `/list` - Display all currently tracked active items
- `/expiring <days>` - View items expiring within the specified number of days
- `/bills` - Summary of pending bills and total unpaid amount
- `/add <Name> <YYYY-MM-DD> [Category] [Amount]` - Manually register an item
- `/delete <id>` - Remove an item from tracking
